capabilities: fuzzy-search Google Drive folders within configured root folders
attach a Drive folder to a note and store the link in frontmatter
open the linked folder in a browser from the Properties pane
search across My Drive and Shared Drives
attach or open folders via command palette and context menu
extras: Users must create their own Google Cloud OAuth credentials (Client ID and Secret) and configure the OAuth consent screen before use; Drive access is read-only (drive.readonly scope).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to link a note to a Google Drive folder in My Drive or Shared Drives and open it from the note.

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth Client ID and Secret

summary: Google Drive integration that attaches a Drive folder to a note via fuzzy search and opens it with one click from the properties pane.
